description:
Gruntz (Hybrid) 1g

Gruntz is made by crossing Gelato and Skittles, Gruntz produces an uplifting sensation that leaves consumers feeling focused, tingly and euphoric. Gruntz has a tropical flavor profile, with undertones of grapefruit.
